name: WeatherBench 2: Benchmark for Next-Generation Data-Driven Global Weather Models
description: WeatherBench 2 is an open-access, cloud-native benchmark for training and evaluating data-driven global weather forecasting models, created by Google Research and ECMWF. Derived from the ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis and high-resolution operational forecasts, it provides standardized, analysis-ready Zarr datasets at multiple spatial resolutions. It establishes a rigorous evaluation framework measuring skill scores and extreme event predictions.
